name: Vulcan VPRO Flight Outdoor Ball (6-Pack)
description: The Vulcan VPRO Flight is a tournament-grade outdoor pickleball with 40 precision-drilled holes and a seamless rotomolded shell. It is engineered for a consistent bounce in cold weather, staying crack-resistant down to 40°F, which makes it a strong choice for winter and early-spring outdoor play.
care_instructions: Store balls in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Rotate out balls that develop soft spots or lose roundness. Rinse with water and air dry after muddy sessions.
